description: This file defines an abstract base class for Smarty template resource handlers, providing properties and methods for managing compiled template content, dependencies, caching, and rendering.

classes.name: Smarty_Template_Resource_Base
classes.description: Abstract base class for Smarty template resource handlers managing compiled template state, content, dependencies, and rendering process.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Abstract method to process the template resource with a given Smarty_Internal_Template instance.

methods.name: getRenderedTemplateCode
methods.description: Renders the template content by calling the compiled or cached template code, handling callbacks and exceptions.

methods.name: getTimeStamp
methods.description: Retrieves the file modification timestamp for the resource if available.
